name: Rust CLI tool
description: A Rust CLI tool with command injection (Command::new("sh")), path traversal, MD5 hashing, insecure random (thread_rng for a token), unsafe blocks and hard-coded credentials. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings from the Rust token scanner.

fixes.title: Load credentials from environment variables
fixes.explanation: Secrets are read from env at runtime; rotate any that were committed.
edits: fn api_key() -> String { std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY not set") }

fixes.title: Remove the shell; pass a fixed argv to Command
fixes.explanation: No shell expands the argument, so metacharacters cannot break out of it.

fixes.title: Canonicalize and confine the path
fixes.explanation: canonicalize resolves symlinks and ../; starts_with confirms the result is inside the base.

fixes.title: Use SHA-256 instead of MD5
fixes.explanation: sha2::Sha256 is not broken. Use argon2 or bcrypt for password storage.

fixes.title: Use OsRng instead of thread_rng
fixes.explanation: OsRng draws from the OS entropy source and cannot be predicted.
edits:
let token: u64 = rand::thread_rng().gen();
    println!("token: {}", token);

fixes.title: Replace unsafe pointer dereference with safe slice access
fixes.explanation: Rust slice indexing performs bounds checking; raw pointer arithmetic skips it and can cause UB.
